title: feat: add bounded retention and appearance transfer
body:
## P6 follow-up — product polish completion slice

Stacked after PR #26 (`completion/byok-followup`); PRs #17–#26 remain draft.

- adds preview-first local retention controls for derived history with age bounds, a 256-record deletion ceiling, exact confirmation, stale-preview checks, and a transaction that protects immutable sources, audit rows, managed-model records, external-generation evidence, and response artifacts
- adds versioned, normalized, 8 KiB-bounded appearance JSON import/export with unknown-field filtering and browser-preview/local-only boundaries
- exposes typed Tauri commands and accessible Settings controls with honest loading, empty, error, and unsupported states
- validates with 84 TypeScript tests, 106 Rust tests, typecheck, Vite build, cargo fmt/check/test, and diff checks via canonical BL4 app_server

P6 remains IN PROGRESS pending native Tauri/WebView accessibility/smoke acceptance, security/publication gates, and final desktop evidence.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
